messages:
maria: Heads-up — during the staging base-image rebuild this morning the image signer step failed with a KMS permission denied. Holding the rebuild until we confirm RBAC and audit settings.

jonathan: Which key and operation?

maria: Using projects/redwood-prod/locations/global/keyRings/artifacts/cryptoKeys/image-signer: EncryptDecrypt. Error from cosign: 'rpc error: code = PermissionDenied desc = permission denied for cryptoKeyVersions/cryptoKeyVersionName'

sre-sarah: @maria can you paste the exact cosign command and the pod logs?

maria: cosign sign --key kms://gcp/projects/redwood-prod/locations/global/keyRings/artifacts/cryptoKeys/image-signer \nPod log snippet: 
```
2026-03-23T09:12:03Z ERROR signing: rpc error: code = PermissionDenied desc = requestor does not have permission to use key
```

devops-lee: I checked IAM, the staging service account still has roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyEncrypterDecrypter but we recently tightened the key's IAM to only specific members. Might be missing the new service account binding.

paul: Also noticed audit logs for this key are not appearing in the same project — staging audit export was pointed to a logging sink that got deleted last week. Auditor flagged missing KMS audit trail.

auditor-jen: Confirming — I see gaps for 03/23 09:00-09:20 in key usage logs. That's exactly when the canary ran. Need audit log restoration for incident review.

sec-bot: Automated check: key rotation policy OK. Last rotation 2025-10-01. KMS IAM last modified 2026-03-20 by jonathan.

jonathan: My change was the principle-of-least-privilege update. I removed broad service account binding and added a new workload identity binding. Looks like the builder SA didn't get the new identity mapping.

devops-lee: Quick repro on staging: run `gcloud kms keys get-iam-policy artifacts --keyring=artifacts --location=global --project=redwood-prod` shows missing member 'serviceAccount:builder-staging@redwood-prod.iam.gserviceaccount.com' in bindings for roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyEncrypterDecrypter.

maria: TL;DR: signer pod running as builder-staging SA, but KMS policy only allows workload identity service account principal.

paul: Proposed remediation: 1) Re-add builder-staging SA to key IAM temporarily to unblock staging rebuild, 2) Update workload identity config for the builder in k8s, 3) Re-run canary with increased audit retention, 4) Run vuln scan on newly signed images.

auditor-jen: Need step 0: export existing logs and create a durable sink before re-adding any permissions. We need forensic trail.

sre-sarah: Agreed. I'll create a sink to logging.project-redwood-audit and backfill what we can. Then we can rebind.

jonathan: I can push the workload identity mapping and a small RBAC doc. But to be safe, let's do a short embargo: no prod rollouts until keys & audit are verified.

devops-lee: I'll run the IAM change now with a short TTL binding using gcloud: 
```
gcloud kms keys add-iam-policy-binding image-signer \
  --location=global --keyring=artifacts --member=serviceAccount:builder-staging@redwood-prod.iam.gserviceaccount.com \
  --role=roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyEncrypterDecrypter
```

maria: Please annotate the change with the ticket #SEC-5124 and add a note in the audit channel.

devops-lee: Done. binding added at 2026-03-23T09:18Z. Temporary binding expires in 2h (manual cleanup).

sec-bot: Alert posted to #auditsink: missing logs backfilled from 09:00-09:20. Confirmed export to logging.project-redwood-audit.

auditor-jen: I see backfill partial — some events are gone (retention policy gap). Capture what we have and file an evidence packet.

paul: Next actions and owners:
- devops-lee: remove temp binding after successful canary (ETA 2h)
- jonathan: push workload identity mapping + doc (ETA 1h)
- sre-sarah: validate sink & retention, backfill evidence (ETA 30m)
- maria: re-run staging canary sign after RBAC fix (ETA after others)

maria: I'll wait for confirmation from @sre-sarah and then re-run. If canary signs cleanly we do a limited PROD rollout with audit-monitoring on.

jonathan: Also adding a small test to our CI that fails if KMS sign results in PermissionDenied to catch this earlier.

sre-sarah: Noted. I'll also add an alert on missing KMS admin activity logs so we get a pager if sink is removed.

maria: Thanks everyone. Please keep updates here.

devops-lee: Update — canary re-run succeeded at 2026-03-23T09:27Z, cosign returned signature, image pushed to staging registry.

auditor-jen: Evidence packet created: link https://logs.redwood.internal/audit/SEC-5124-evidence (internal).

maria: Closing the hold. Leaving the temporary binding in place until workload identity is confirmed. Will follow up in SEC-5124. :white_check_mark:
